title: AsyncMixVLA: Runtime Asynchronous Robot Policy Switching for Adaptation to Dynamic Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.28585v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models translate visual observations and language instructions into robot actions, enabling general-purpose robotic control. However, environmental perturbations, such as objects moving during execution, can undermine their reliability. Different policies exhibit complementary failures under mid-rollout perturbations, motivating selective switching between policies for recovery. Such switching can stall the robot during inference of the newly invoked policy or, if performed asynchronously, act on stale observations. We present AsyncMixVLA, an adaptive inference framework for proactive, asynchronous switching across heterogeneous VLA policies. A learned trigger balances recovery potential against intervention harm to selectively escalate to a higher-compute policy. AsyncMixVLA overlaps its inference with committed outgoing actions and aligns its context to the anticipated takeover state. On LIBERO-Long with

translated_title: AsyncMixVLA：面向动态环境自适应的运行时异步机器人策略切换
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉观测和语言指令转化为机器人动作，从而实现通用机器人控制。然而，环境扰动（例如物体在执行过程中发生移动）可能会损害其可靠性。不同的策略在执行中途遇到扰动时表现出互补的失败模式，这促使人们有选择地在策略之间进行切换以实现恢复。这种切换可能导致机器人在新调用的策略进行推理期间停顿，或者如果异步执行，则会基于过时的观测采取行动。我们提出了AsyncMixVLA，这是一个用于在异构VLA策略之间进行主动异步切换的自适应推理框架。一个学习得到的触发器在恢复潜力与干预危害之间进行权衡，从而有选择地升级到更高计算量的策略。AsyncMixVLA将其推理与已提交的输出动作重叠进行，并将其上下文与预期的接管状态对齐。在LIBERO-Long上（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出AsyncMixVLA自适应推理框架，通过学习型触发器在恢复潜力与干预代价之间进行权衡，实现异构VLA策略间的主动异步切换，推理与已提交动作重叠执行并对齐预期接管状态，使机器人能够在动态环境中实现可靠恢复。
en_tdlr: AsyncMixVLA enables proactive asynchronous switching across heterogeneous VLA policies via a learned trigger that balances recovery potential against intervention harm, overlapping inference with committed actions and aligning context to the anticipated takeover state for reliable recovery in dynamic environments.
